head: pañcāmṛta
target: go ku da ha na yongs su gyur pa'i bdud rtsi lnga dang sha lnga oM hUM khaM swa hUM dang bcas pa rnams te/ de nas rlung gis bskul ba'i mes gdungs pas thod pa na gnas pa'i rdzas bcu bsros pa'i rlangs pas mtho gang gi bar can gyi steng gi bar snang la hUM las skyes shing hUM gis mtshan pa'i rdo rje sngon po la reg pas zhu nas zhugs pa las thams cad ro gcig par smin pa'i steng du mtho gang gi bar na oM las skyes shing oM yig gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi oM yig gi 'od zer gyis bkug pa phyogs bcu na gnas pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa'i byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi rnams dang / nor bu dang sngags dang / sman gyi nus pa'i bye brag rnams dang lhan cig zhugs pa na/ de thams cad dngul chu'i mdog can ba mo'i phung po bzhin du bsil ba'i bdud rtsi de nyid gsum gyis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs te/
src_sentence: tadupari tryakṣarajātatrimuṇḍaniviṣṭāmāḥ kārajaṃ padma- oṃ abhiṣiñcantu bho maṃgala- bho mukuṭa- bho devī- bho saptama: paṭala: bhājanaṃ tanmadhye sārddhacandrānusvāra vi ra śu ma mu go ku da ha na pariṇatāni pañcāmṛtapañcamāṃsāni oṃ hū~ kha~ svaḥ hū~ sahitāni tato vātapreritatāpena tapyamāna- kapālastharasadravyaṃ śodhyavāṣpasparśādupari vitastyantarāntarīkṣastha hū~ ja hū~ garbhanīla- dambholervilīya praveśātsarvaikarasapākopari vitastyantarasya oṃ jaukārādhiṣṭhita- sudhāṃśumaṇḍalasya oṃ kāraraśmisamākṛṣṭairdaśadigvarttibhistathāgatādayo hi bodhicittā- mṛtairmaṇimaṃtrauṣādhiśaktiviśeṣaiśca saha praveśe tat sarvānpāradavarṇastuṣāra- rāśiriva śītalamamṛtaṃ tristritatvenādhiṣṭhāya tena śubhra hū~ja sa raśminālikaikaśūkaṃ vajrarasana- mātmānaṃ maṇḍaladevatāśca santarpayediti maṇḍalarājaśrīnāma dvitīyaḥ samādhiḥ

head: tathā
target: ji ltar dmigs pa'i snying rje chen po de kho na nyid ma mthong ba'i yod pa ma yin pa lhag par mos pas bsgom bzhin pa ni de kho na nyid rtogs pa na rtogs pa'i bdag nyid kyi phyir kun rdzob pa'i lhan cig skyes par brjod pa de bzhin du bde ba res 'ga' nyams su myong ba'i gnas skabs su dang / nyams su ma myong ba'i gnas skabs su de kho na nyid ma mthong bas lhag par mos pas snying rje chen po dang dbyer med pa'i rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi bdag nyid rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan pas/ sgom pa ni de kho na nyid rtogs pa'i gnas skabs su 'jig rten las 'das pa'i kun rdzob pa'i lhan cig skyes par brjod do/ /
src_sentence: tathā sukhaṃ kadācidanubhavāvasthāyāmananubhavāvasthāyāṃ cādṛṣṭatattvenā- dhimokṣeṇa mahākṛpā'bhinnasvabhāvaṃ śūnyatātmakaṃ sarvākāravarayutaṃ bhāvyamānatattvā- āryamañjuśrīnāmasaṅgīti dhigamāvasthāyāṃ lokottaraṃ sāṃvṛtaṃ sahajamucyate|
